notes: Weather now appears on your panels. The weather service shipped a few releases ago but nothing was ever built to set it up or draw it, so there was no way to see it and no location for it to read.
Control Panel, General tab, has a new Weather section: type a town, pick it from the results, choose Celsius or Fahrenheit. That is set once for the machine.
Panel Settings has a Show weather switch on each panel, because which panels show it is a per-panel choice. Turn it on for as many panels as you like.

The OG Widget draws it as a group alongside CPU and GPU — temperature, sky, feels-like, humidity and wind, under the town name. Content amount applies to it as it does to everything else: Minimal shows the temperature alone, Relaxed adds…

It follows the same honesty rule as the sensors: if no location is set, the fetch failed, or the reading has aged out, nothing is drawn at all. No placeholder, and never an old temperature presented as current.
